name: How much does room addition framing cost per square foot?

mainEntity.name: How much does room addition framing cost per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of room addition framing per square foot can vary significantly. Factors influencing cost include the complexity of the design, the type of materials used (e.g., standard lumber vs. engineered wood or steel), local labor rates, and the accessibility of the site. On average, framing costs might range from $15 to $35 per square foot, but this is a rough estimate and does not include other construction phases like foundation, roofing, or finishes. A detailed quote from a contractor is necessary for an accurate cost assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing costs vary, typically from $15 to $35 per square foot, influenced by design complexity, materials, and labor. This estimate excludes other construction phases.
